A.page_notes:
[corrected] Second-reader check: all 24 pages read, with zoomed crops of every ambiguous region. Page-to-student assignment confirmed: 8 students x 3 pages each, in order (A-01 p1-3, A-02 p4-6, A-03 p7-9, A-04 p10-12, A-05 p13-15, A-06 p16-18, A-07 p19-21, A-08 p22-24). No missed or merged students; ids unchanged. No blank, duplicated or missing pages. Several photos are tilted/rotated a few degrees and curled but readable. Each student's first page has a short diagonal stroke at the top-left (looks like a collector/teacher mark, not student work). Names are covered by a thumb; on page 7 a fragment of the name line and on several pages a partial date are visible - deliberately not recorded. Cross-sheet bleed: the faint 'pri...' at the bottom of page 14 and the pencil text at the bottom of page 15 are the edge of A-06's page-16 sheet lying under A-05's; the scribble at the top-right of page 24 and the "Py / V" at the top-left of page 21 are other sheets underneath. Faint mirrored text is show-through from the reverse side (e.g. page 22's red side code shows through at the bottom of page 23, so p22/p23 are one double-sided sheet).
CHANGES FROM THE FIRST DRAFT: Scores - A-06 p4 4.5 -> 4 (silver_value reads clearly as 10); A-07 p1 2.5 -> 2 ('Fire ball' is a wrong value under the one-flaw rule); A-08 p1 1 -> 0.5 (items 1 and 3 each have two flaws) and p4 1.5 -> 1 (gold_value reads as 50, not ambiguous). Help suspicion - A-05 medium -> low-medium, A-07 medium -> low, A-08 low-medium -> low (A-07's and A-08's own planning notes show the shared Part 2 answer was reasoned out independently); A-03/A-04 stay high with one more shared quirk added. Experience - A-05 developing -> emerging. Transcription - A-02's Part 4 values sit one line too high; A-03/A-04's printed answers explained as the bonus-line result + 15.
SCORING CONVENTIONS used: P1 per item 1 = correct name + '=' + correct value with valid quotes; 0.5 = exactly one flaw (wrong/altered name OR missing/unbalanced quotes OR wrong value); 0 = two+ flaws or not an assignment. P2 = 1 per blank (4, 10, *12, *2, pizza_cost + soda_cost); a literal 68 / 48+20 for total_cost = 0.5. P3 multiplicands: exact parameter = 1, approximate parameter name or correct literal (10 / 5) = 0.5, else 0; return: total = 1, literal 50 = 0.5, undefined name or other = 0. P4 = 1 per scratch line + printed answer; 0.5 where the reading is truly ambiguous.
CROSS-STUDENT PATTERNS: (a) 0 of 8 completed Part 3 correctly - nobody wrote base_attack * bonus_multiplier / return total; 6 used literals (only A-06 and A-07 used the correct literals 10 * 5 / return 50), 1 used approximate names (A-01), 1 left it blank (A-05). (b) 4 of 8 (A-05, A-06, A-07, A-08) wrote player_name (the example's name) instead of the requested 'character' - students copy the example's identifiers.
